newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico creates toll road commission.
newsitem.headline: Mexico creates toll road commission.

text.p: Mexico's Ministry of Communications and Transport said in a statement on Monday it has created a commission to oversee the country's growing toll road network.
The new commission will ensure that the companies operating toll roads meet the terms of their concessions, it said.

The commission will also be responsible for helping the finance ministry restructure debt taken on by private companies that built toll roads in the past few years, but were hurt by the country's recent economic crisis.
"The commission will verify the financial state of the companies that operate toll roads and will also monitor the movement of vehicles on the country's toll roads," it said.
